name: firmware-budget
description: Shows flash and RAM use of a firmware ELF above the prompt after every build, and holds a commit that is over budget

elf.title: ELF path
elf.description: Path to the linked firmware ELF, relative to the project root, for example build/firmware.elf

flash_budget.title: Flash budget (bytes)
flash_budget.description: Largest text + data the firmware may occupy. Pico 2 ships with 4 MB of flash.

ram_budget.title: RAM budget (bytes)
ram_budget.description: Largest RAM image the linker may place, including the SDK's minimum heap and stack. The RP2350 has 520 KB of SRAM.

ram_start.title: RAM start address
ram_start.description: Sections at or above this address count as RAM, below it as flash. RP2040 and RP2350 SRAM starts at 0x20000000.

size_tool.title: size tool
size_tool.description: The binutils size command for your toolchain

build_pattern.title: Build command pattern
build_pattern.description: Regular expression; a Bash command that matches it is treated as a build
